method:
Zero-paid reconstruction of each memory-on paid prompt's ELIGIBLE set (Codex CP4 review 21, ruling 6; review 22, rulings 2-3; review 23, ruling 2), from the archived store
(evidence/store-archive, read-only; no Redis, no Docker): the AOF's commands in order, each stream entry's id being its
transaction time. Writes evidence/served-reconstruction.json; make_paid_attempts.py reads it for R2, R4's serving half and R6.

Eligible is what a successful read serves. The host serves none when the read fails or times out (spec.py `_serve_memory`), so
what was actually served is either the eligible set or empty: a subset of it. That settles a prohibited version's absence
(R4); a citation's presence (R2) also needs proof that the read succeeded, which this file does not give.

What a turn is served (src/optimus/context/memory_serving.py `from_store` at every paid head, checked below): the project's
items whose latest confirmed version is servable (trust not off, status active, `context_engine.memory_projection`) and has a
statement, minus branch-limited items on another branch and items whose pinned file changed (both come from the item's
lineage), then at most 50 user items and 3 agent lessons. For a prompt, the served set is derived only when the inputs fix it:
- the confirmed view is known: every event at or before the window's start was confirmed before it. A `durable` watermark's
  value is an event id, not the time it was set, so the SET must be followed in the AOF by a stream entry whose id is at or
  before the window's start. Redis gives an entry an id no earlier than its execution time, so that entry, and the SET before
  it, ran by then. A host command's recorded success is no proof: it reports a durable save, whose projection may still be
  pending (memory_store `_confirm`, review 23 ruling 2), and no retained record carries projection_state. Only events that
  decide eligibility need this: an item whose newest version is servable, or whose newest version ends an earlier servable one;
- no item event falls inside the window, so the read time within it cannot matter;
- every servable item's lineage has no branch limit and no file pin, so no workspace or branch state is needed;
- no agent lesson exists and at most 50 user items do, so no ranking or limit applies.
Otherwise the prompt is UNKNOWN, with the input that is missing.
